name: Hidden Rush
target_audience: English-speaking curious adults 18–34 fascinated by the mind and why people do what they do
audience_problems: feel they don't understand their own impulses
short attention, crave depth without fluff
audience_desires: a sense of uncovering something hidden
insight they can apply to themselves
value_proposition: Faceless, documentary-grade psychology that reveals the hidden machinery behind everyday behavior.
positioning: Calm, mysterious, intellectually honest — the opposite of loud hustle content.
fact_check_rules: every empirical claim carries a claim_id linked to a source
no invented studies, numbers or quotes
hook_style: cold open with an unsettling question, no greeting
narrative_framework: open loop → tension → reveal → applied payoff
cta_rules: soft CTA only at the end

visual_style_bible.backgrounds: deep navy with subtle grain, minimal negative space
visual_style_bible.typography: clean geometric sans, sparse on-screen text

characters.name: The Everyman
characters.proportions: simple stickman, round head, 5-head body ratio
characters.clothing: no clothing detail, pure line figure
characters.face_details: two dot eyes, no mouth unless needed

tts.voice_instructions: calm male-neutral narration, ~138 wpm, controlled, documentary; pauses at semantic breaks

music_sfx_rules: no stock whooshes; subtle risers only at turns
thumbnail_system: single dominant stickman + one glowing focal object, <=3 words, high contrast on navy
experiment_rules: no global rule from a single video
